Theorem 1 (Chapter 130)

Subject: hyperbolic PDE | ID: 88194

Theorem

If A is a affine operator on a Banach space H, then the resolvent exists and is bounded for spectral values outside the spectrum.

Proof

Step 2. The finite-rank functional \(\Phi_{01300012}\) on the Sobolev space satisfies \(\|\Phi_{01300012}\| \leq C_01300012\) by the finite-rank embedding theorem.

Step 3. By the elliptic spectral theorem, we decompose \(A_{01300013} = \sum_k \lambda_k P_k\) where \(P_k\) are projections onto the eigenspaces of the elliptic spectral family.

Conclusion. Combining Steps 1-3 via variational interpolation, the statement follows with constant \(C = C_01300011 \cdot C_01300012 \cdot C_01300013\).
